whyThisGrade: LOW because I could not check the point of the mission, and I will not call a build good on what I could not see. The point of the mission is 29 things — Reviews entry screen is the landing view…, Collection screen shows each bucket…, Builder matches the mockup… and 26 more — and 1 couldn't be checked. Known issues shipping with it: primary action buttons break the mockup's button styling — you asked for the mockup's compact horizontal action buttons with small inline…; the build gives the green Pull-data and Continue buttons rendering oversized stacked… (prd-21); the Pull data & start button's oversized icon — you asked for a compact green button with a small inline download icon and 'Pull…; the build gives an oversized download icon (55px in a 38px control) stacked above the… (part-pull data start) and the Continue to builder button's oversized icon — you asked for a compact green button with a small inline arrow and 'Continue to…; the build gives an oversized arrow icon (61px in a 32px control) with the label… (part-continueBtn). I could not check 31 things — Walking the flow…, Refresh-all lives in an amber warning…, Wired KPI value cells show the value… and 28 more; 21 smaller items I could not check, and they don't change the grade: The Kpi interface exposes optional previousValue…, A snapshot JSON object omitting every…, sourceDeltas reuses the existing… and 18 more — see the list.

escalations: The project's test suite came back 'failed' (7 of 597), but every failure is contamination from the Verify walk itself writing to disk: the failing diffs contain the walk's own typed text ('Number One typed this to see it carry') and a new walk-created snapshot '2026-09-20.0' that the snapshot-listing tests then picked up. These are not clean build defects — they are the verify run mutating the shared data/snapshots fixtures. Re-run the suite from a clean checkout before reading anything into it.

This seed has no wired/automated KPIs (every KPI is 'Manual', the pull reported '0 values pulled'), so the wired value-cell, Collect/Re-collect chips and the Refresh-all/'Update all automatically' box could not be exercised at all. summary: Captain, your MBR builder is in good shape: the Reviews landing, the collect screen, the redesigned builder, the draft banner, the completion meter, cohort/carried/manual rendering, autosave-and-persist, the Preview read-only path and the month-only lock gate all work — the lock dialog does open at 19/19 (the walk's text-diff missed the overlay, but the screenshot shows it plainly). The one real parity problem is cosmetic but visible: the primary green buttons ('Pull data & start', 'Continue to builder', and to a lesser degree 'Lock month') render oversized icons with labels wrapped onto two or three lines instead of the mockup's compact single-line buttons. Two whole areas — wired-KPI collect cells and the Refresh-all box — couldn't be checked because this seed has no automated KPIs, and the failing test run is contamination from the verify walk, not a build defect. Every high-impact criterion I could reach worked; ship with the button styling and the named unchecked areas as known items.
